title: App crashes when attempting to delete a site after logging into Luxor Cloud
description: The application crashes after a user logs into Luxor Cloud, selects a site, enters edit mode, and attempts to delete the selected site. Instead of returning to the network mode, the app terminates.
steps: Tap the hamburger menu icon in the top-left corner.
Enter valid email address and password.
Tap the trash can icon in the top-right corner of the 'Test' site details screen.
Tap 'OK' on the 'Delete Site' confirmation dialog.
actual: The application crashes and closes after the user confirms the deletion of a site.
expected: After confirming the deletion of the site, the application should return to the network mode screen or a relevant previous screen.
